name: fast-video-cataloger
description: Search, view and tag your local video library from Claude: transcripts, scenes, visual search.
long_description:
Fast Video Cataloger keeps a searchable catalog of your own video files on Windows: scene thumbnails, keywords, transcripts and faces. This extension lets Claude work with that catalog. Find videos and moments by what was said or by what the picture shows (visual search, nothing tagged first), fetch scene thumbnails to judge a shot, and, with an Editor key, add keywords and gather clips into bins.

**Requires Fast Video Cataloger 10.4 or later** (Windows, free 30-day trial) with your catalog shared through its server: in the program, open the start page's Server section and click Setup. Create an API key with Manage Users in the same section: Viewer to search and read, Editor to also tag and build bins.

The extension talks to the Fast Video Cataloger server on your own computer. No video is uploaded; Claude receives the titles, transcript lines and scene images it asks for.
